description: This Dart source file defines the 'ReaderScreen' widget, which is the main reading interface of a Flutter app. It manages layout including chapter navigation, reading pane, notes sidebar, and bottom actions navigation. It interacts with application state for books and annotations, and adjusts its layout depending on screen width.

classes.description: StatefulWidget representing the main reading screen with configurable layout depending on screen width.

methods.description: Initializes the state, including setting up annotations loading when the chapter changes.
